name: Santo Domingo
living: the merengue band in the right-field stands bobs and strums in a slow loop (guitars, bass and hats moving)
the flag on the hillside ripples in the sea breeze
the white sailboat drifts slowly across the turquoise sea (sprite-able)
the Caribbean sea sparkles with slow golden glints near the horizon
palm fronds sway lazily beside the cathedral and along the hillside
the cathedral's stone bell tower catches a warm golden glint that slides as the sun lowers
fluffy golden clouds drift slowly across the blue sky (sky layer drift)
the DALE DURO board's letters blink softly after a home run
a few seagulls glide across the sky now and then
crowd shimmer in the colourful left-field stands, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
